_comment: Which unreleased products may be PRE-ORDERED. Hand-edited: add a slug here
and that product becomes buyable before its release date; the files stay
locked until midnight ET on that date either way.
products (src/data/digital.json) — fonts, packs, plugins. Two lists rather
than one because the two namespaces are independent and a shared list would
let a name collision open sales on the wrong thing.
This lives in its own file rather than as a `preorder` field on the product
because src/data/music-catalog.json is REGENERATED wholesale by
scripts/sync-music-catalog.mjs from the brain DB on every build — a flag
A slug listed here that is already released is a harmless no-op: the date
always wins. A slug with no usable release date is refused outright — a
pre-order is a promise about a date, and with no date there is no promise.
Opt-in on purpose. Not every future-dated product should be on sale early
— announcing one is a decision, and the default for a date that simply has
not arrived yet is still 'not for sale'.
